d:
Bernie Sanders declares that Democrats must use their new congressional majority to take on America's billionaire oligarchs, corporate greed and a rigged economy. Taking aim at Elon Musk and the ultra-rich, Sanders demands a 5% wealth tax, stronger workers' rights, Medicare for All and an end to billionaire influence over elections. He warns that Democrats cannot afford to return to business as usual.
